skin.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE original game sprite sheet image, 1024x1536 portrait PNG with TRUE transparent alpha.
Character skin: "Khuy Niet Loi Ton", Thunder Sovereign who broke through Nirvana. Entirely original design for our own fantasy RPG. Do not imitate any existing anime, donghua, game character or poster.
The attached reference public/assets/tudo-ma-ton-v1/skin.png is STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY: match its polished semi-realistic 3D fantasy-RPG rendering, body proportions, sprite scale, cleanliness, and 2x2 arrangement. DO NOT copy its costume, shoulder beasts, crown, red colors or dark background.

COMPOSITION: FOUR isolated full-body sprites, exactly 2 columns and 2 rows. TOP LEFT adult male standing; TOP RIGHT adult female standing; BOTTOM LEFT same male seated cross-legged meditating; BOTTOM RIGHT same female seated cross-legged meditating. Top row occupies upper approximately 56% of canvas height. Fit standing sprites inside x=28..482 and x=542..996, y=22..842. Fit seated sprites inside those same column bounds, y=904..1510. Keep entire heads, hair, hands, robe tails, feet inside their own cell. Broad completely transparent vertical gutter centered x=512, horizontal gutter centered y=873, and transparent outer margins. Nothing touches edges or neighboring cells. All four depicted from front; same costume and identity consistently across each gender's two poses.

MALE: tall powerful adult man about 30, intense handsome East Asian face, sharp brows, striking GOLDEN eyes. Very long wild flowing SILVER-WHITE hair falling past waist with loose strands, constrained inside his cell. Fine GOLD forehead circlet, a thin gold chain across brow with small gold flame-shaped center ornament, no crown.
FEMALE: tall adult woman about 25, fierce elegant East Asian face, golden eyes, same very long silver-white hair and delicate thin gold forehead chain with small flame center ornament.

COSTUME BOTH: layered robes in black and deep royal violet with gold trim, high wide collar, one long violet-black outer cloak draped from shoulders, gold-and-black belt with violet jade buckle, long split robe tails, black boots. No beast shoulder armor. Signature thin GLOWING GOLD CRACK-VEIN markings like gold kintsugi lightning cracks on visible neck, hands and forearms; matching gold crack embroidery on robe front. Local glow contained on skin and embroidery only; no light spilling into transparent gutters. Male robe cross-collared slightly open at upper chest revealing a little gold crack-vein skin. Female robe modest HIGH CLOSED collar, NO cleavage. Broad clear folds and big readable shapes crisp at small LIVE sprite size; no micro-filigree.

POSES: Standing figures with open golden eyes, confident stance, arms relaxed slightly apart, empty hands visible with correct fingers. Seated figures straight spine, eyes CLOSED, cross-legged lotus-like meditation, both hands palms up on knees, empty hands and correct fingers.
Soft upper-left studio illumination on bodies only; polished semi-realistic 3D materials, opaque clothing, clean silhouette edges.

BACKGROUND: actual alpha=0 everywhere outside the four bodies, including four corners, center vertical gutter and horizontal gutter. No environment, ground, platform, cast shadow, halo, aura, lightning bolts, smoke, particles, text, watermark, weapons, dragons, wings or pets. Do not paint a checkerboard or solid color background. Produce one sheet only.

dragon.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original fantasy creature artifact named "Tu Loi Long". Output a square 1024x1024 PNG with TRUE transparent alpha background.
Subject: Exactly ONE Eastern Chinese long serpentine spirit DRAGON made of violet lightning and storm energy, with one head, a long continuous serpentine body, one tail, and four small clawed legs.
Pose and composition: Its long body coils into a loose upright C / crescent shape as if wrapping around someone's shoulders from behind, with an open interior negative space. Head at UPPER RIGHT, facing left-forward, jaws open in a fierce roar; swept-back horns and flowing whiskers. Tail curls downward at LOWER LEFT. Strong, readable silhouette with controlled detail, not noisy. The entire dragon occupies about 85% of the canvas, with generous clear transparent margins on all sides; horns, whiskers, claws, and tail fully visible, nothing touches the edges.
Materials: Semi-translucent glowing violet-purple scales with bright white-violet electric veins embedded in and hugging the body. A few small golden accents on the horns and claws. Polished semi-realistic 3D fantasy game-art rendering, refined sculptural anatomy, crisp material definition and premium lighting comparable in rendering quality only to the supplied sabre reference. Design an entirely new creature; do not include a weapon.
Background: Fully transparent alpha, including the open interior of the crescent. No environment, no person, no pedestal, no ground or cast shadow, no backdrop color, no detached lightning bolts, no outer haze, no surrounding glow cloud. Keep energy attached tightly to the dragon's body. No text, no watermark. Generate only one image.
